QuestInfo.name: Concerned Townspeople
QuestInfo.1: Start with Anne. Exit the Magic Library and find Anne crouching to the left. \r\n#b(You can check her location by clicking the 'NPC' button on the mini map on the upper left when you exit the Magic Library.)
QuestInfo.2: You met the Lone Girl Anne.

0.0: There is one townsperson I know of who needs help. If it's okay with you, I'll introduce them to you.

yes.0: First, you should go to Anne. She's Dr. Betty's daughter. I'm sure Dr. Betty's very busy, because Anne has seemed particularly bored these days.
yes.1: She's usually a very perky girl, so it broke my heart to see her all sad. She might feel better if someone were to take care of her...

no.0: Huh, you don't need me to? All right.

1.0: #b(She's crouched down, doodling so intently that she doesn't even notice your approach. Talk to her in a bit.)#k
